body:
MAINLINE-009 keeps its geometry. This column adds the wrinkling coefficient at two levels. Foam design Q is 0.50, the NASA CR-1457 lower bound. The theoretical band stated for a perfect face is 0.78 to 0.91. The comparison value is 0.82. Hoff and Mautner, Allen, and Plantema were not opened. QUESTIONABLE.

Design wrinkling SF is 0.235167984044. At Q 0.82 it is 0.385675493833. At 0.78 and 0.91 it is 0.366862055109 and 0.428005730961. The lesser factor stays 0.23515931325, because handbook buckling does not use Q. The wrinkling-precision gap is (0.82/0.50)^3 = 4.410944 on Ec times Gc.

Honeycomb design coefficient 0.33 is equation 2.2-14. Equation 2.2-12 leads with 0.8. On the Hexcel 32 kg/m3 row, wrinkling SF rises from 0.145667432154 to 0.353133168858, and the lesser factor becomes handbook buckling at 0.26626666436. Not a certification.
